question: Who are the co-authors of the book "Original Sin," published in May 2025?

options.text: P. D. James and Gideon Haigh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Jake Tapper and Alex Thompson**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled **"Original Sin"** is a collaborative work co-authored by **Jake Tapper** and **Alex Thompson**, scheduled for release in **May 2025**.
 
• **Jake Tapper** is a well-known **American** journalist, author, and the lead Washington anchor for **CNN**. He is the host of the popular news program **"The Lead with Jake Tapper"**.
 
• **Alex Thompson** is a prominent **national political correspondent** currently working with **Axios** and was formerly a reporter at **Politico**. He is highly regarded for his investigative reporting on the **White House** and **presidential administrations**.
 
• The publication is expected to delve into the intricate layers of **American politics**, leveraging the combined expertise of **Tapper's** narrative style and **Thompson's** deep-seated political reporting skills.
 
• The book is positioned as a significant addition to the **political literature** of **2025**, offering insights into the power dynamics and historical contexts within the **United States** government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jake Tapper:**

 
 
• Beyond his career in **broadcast journalism**, **Tapper** is an accomplished author of both **fiction** and **non-fiction**.
 
• His notable fiction works include the **Charlie Marder** series, consisting of **"The Hellfire Club"** (published in **2018**) and **"The Devil May Dance"** (published in **2021**).
 
• His **non-fiction** work, **"The Outpost: An Untold Story of American Valor"** (**2012**), which chronicles the **Battle of Kamdesh** in **Afghanistan**, was a **New York Times** bestseller and was later adapted into a major motion picture.
 
 
 
• **Alex Thompson:**
 
 
• As a journalist, **Thompson** has gained a reputation for breaking news regarding **cabinet appointments**, **campaign strategies**, and **internal political struggles**.
 
• His transition from **Politico** to **Axios** marked a significant move in the **digital media** landscape, focusing on high-impact, concise political analysis.
 
 
 
• **Context of the Title "Original Sin":**
 
 
• In a **political** or **sociological** context, the term **"Original Sin"** often refers to a foundational flaw or a historical event that continues to influence modern-day policy and social structures.
 
• The book likely explores these themes within the framework of **American democracy** or specific **political scandals**.
 
 
 
• **Other Authors Mentioned (Incorrect Options):**
 
 
• **Kathryn Paige Harden** is an **American** psychologist and geneticist known for her book **"The Genetic Lottery"**.
 
• **Dan Brown** is a world-renowned author of thrillers such as **"The Da Vinci Code"** and **"Angels & Demons"**.
 
• **P. D. James** was a celebrated **British** crime novelist, best known for her series featuring detective **Adam Dalgliesh**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The collaboration highlights a growing trend of **broadcast anchors** and **print/digital journalists** teaming up to provide a multi-dimensional view of **current affairs** and **history**.
 
• The release date of **May 2025** places the book's launch during a critical period in the **post-2024 U.S. election** cycle, making it highly relevant for **political analysts** and **historians**.
 
• The book is expected to be a major title for its **publisher**, given the high public profiles of both **Jake Tapper** and **Alex Thompson**.
